notes.title: A note from the developers
notes.content:
Hello gamers,

On a few ocassions, we were asked to release the old hacker games we have developed before the popular Hacker Evolution series.
So we did.
These games are as old as 15 years. We have put all 4 of them into a $0.99 package for the nostalgics and collectors.

Don't expect and amazing 2016 experience :)
The games are pretty much bug free as we fixed almost anything over the years. 

Feel free to address any questions you might have.

If you want to try some of our newest AAA hacking simulation, then please check out Hacker Evolution IMMERSION:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/229560/
